Chapter 1246: 7 Visit (Request For Monthly Tickets)_2

Chapter 1246: Chapter 7 Visit (Request for Monthly Tickets)_2

But now, faced with the disappointment of the Ancestor and the shame of the Ancient Country, Fu Xu Venerate felt that he should do something.

Although this time he was crushed by Galaxy Venerate in the treasured land, it wasn’t entirely his fault. The other Strongest Venerables of the Ancient Country placed in this position would have faced the same outcome.

Yet Fu Xu Venerate was still uneasy; even if it meant paying the price, he wanted the Ancestor to save face somewhat.

“Ancestor, I’ve also cultivated the forbidden supreme legacy, Fu Xu is no match, then let me go.”

“Ancestor, I will also seek out a forbidden supreme legacy to cultivate. I refuse to believe that, with the foundation of Da Fu Ancient Country, we cannot rival just one Galaxy Venerate.”

The Strongest Venerables were uncertain whether they could oppose Galaxy Venerate after cultivating the forbidden supreme legacy, but at least the power gap would narrow. If one couldn’t do it, then two; if two couldn’t, then three.

The foundation of Da Fu Ancient Country is strong enough to overwhelm Galaxy Venerate with sheer force.

…

The blood of the other Strongest Venerables was ignited; as the first Ancient Country, the Ancestor of Da Fu was also the first Perfect Time Being, the highest starting point, so there was no reason they would lose to Galaxy Venerate.

Da Fu Ancestor looked down at the indignant Strongest Venerables eager to challenge Lin Yuan once more, with a slight twitch at the corner of his mouth.

“It’s really unnecessary.” Da Fu Ancestor said, “The strength of that Galaxy Venerate truly exceeds yours. It’s not a disgrace if you can’t match him.”

In the timelines witnessed by Da Fu Ancestor, even he himself, facing Galaxy Venerate after stepping into the Fourth Rank, found it difficult to resist, eventually unable to escape being suppressed. There was no sense of shame in his children losing to Galaxy Venerate in Da Fu Ancestor’s heart.

“Ah?”

The Strongest Venerables were somewhat stunned, surprised that the Ancestor was so forgiving, not minding their loss to Galaxy Venerate, nor intending to regain face?

It was known that Da Fu Ancestor had always been domineering, so when had he ever been so benevolent? Lost is lost? Not even a word, promptly admitting they were outmatched?

“Ancestor, we…”

Fu Xu Venerate and the other Strongest Venerables were a bit puzzled.

“This matter ends here.” Da Fu Ancestor shook his head, glanced at all of the Venerables: “As for Galaxy Venerate, don’t provoke him again, remember, whatever form of provocation is forbidden, don’t even think about revenge, otherwise…”

Da Fu Ancestor surveyed the surroundings, his tone icy: “I will personally punish you.”

The Venerables shivered at his words and quickly said: “Ancestor, we understand.”

As the Ancestor of Da Fu, to not hesitate to personally punish his progeny for an outsider, it was beyond belief for the Venerables. However, they wouldn’t and couldn’t disobey the Ancestor’s orders.

“Alright, you all can withdraw now.”

Da Fu Ancestor had no intention to guide the Venerables anymore; his thoughts were focused on the future timeline of Galaxy Venerate, pondering how to face this future ancestor.

“Fierce Sun.”

Da Fu Ancestor contacted Fierce Sun Ancestor; Galaxy Venerate was a descendant of Fierce Sun Ancestor. Although, through observing the timeline, Da Fu Ancestor knew that the rise of Galaxy Venerate was virtually unrelated to Fierce Sun Ancestor. Even without Fierce Sun Ancestor, the future of Galaxy Venerate wouldn’t change.

But among the six Ancestors, Fierce Sun Ancestor certainly had the closest ties with Galaxy Venerate.

“Da Fu.”

Fierce Sun Ancestor responded, smiling: “What brings you to me?”

“Have you heard about your Fierce Sun Ancient Country’s Galaxy Venerate?” Da Fu Ancestor asked.

“Naturally, I have.” Fierce Sun Ancestor nodded, he was able to observe the future timeline of Lin Yuan, just like Da Fu Ancestor, and perhaps even more detailed.

“It’s my first time seeing such a nearly certain future.” Da Fu Ancestor said with slight amazement.

Only beings of the same level of time life knew how incredible this certain future was.

“The timelines starting from now will change because of Galaxy.” Fierce Sun Ancestor nodded.

Galaxy Venerate’s appearance in this source world as a node spreads out, influencing the timeline extensively due to this future ancestor.

“By the way, I plan to visit Galaxy Venerate, would you mind?” Da Fu Ancestor smiled at Fierce Sun Ancestor.

Having seen the future timelines of Lin Yuan, Da Fu Ancestor naturally couldn’t choose to oppose Galaxy Venerate.

What’s the real power of Fourth Rank time life? Strength? Prowess?

No.

It’s choice.

Time life can make choices most advantageous to themselves by viewing future timelines; this is the greatest method of Fourth Rank beings.

Facing Lin Yuan, avoiding direct confrontation is imperative, lest the outcomes turn dire.

Da Fu Ancestor knew what to do.

“I certainly don’t mind.” Fierce Sun Ancestor shook his head; in reality, it wouldn’t matter even if he did mind. With Lin Yuan’s strength, other ancestors would eventually interact with him, impossible and unnecessary to stop.

“Then that’s good.”

Da Fu Ancestor nodded.

If Fierce Sun Ancestor minded him meeting Galaxy Venerate, he’d do so discreetly anyway, with his methods, meeting Galaxy Venerate wasn’t difficult.

…

Time passed.

In a blink of an eye, several months went by.

Outside the capital of Fierce Sun Country, five figures arrived quietly.

These five figures were indeed the ancestors of the five great ancient countries. After Da Fu Ancestor observed Lin Yuan’s timeline, the other four ancestors also reacted one after another, conducting various observations.

This led to the current scene of the five ancestors visiting Galaxy Venerate together.

As for why the five ancestors chose today for their visit, it was because in numerous future timelines, visiting Galaxy Venerate today was the most suitable; Lin Yuan would be in a good mood, which would be most beneficial in cultivating their relationship with Galaxy Venerate.

“Da Fu, you’ve come as well.” Xuanyin Ancestor with her white long hair flowing, being a tall figure, eyed Da Fu Ancestor with a smile.

“Xuanyin, not just Da Fu, we all came.”

Primordial Ancestor of the Barbaric Wilderness, a towering man, grinned: “I observed Galaxy Venerate’s timeline, discovered he’d step into the Fourth Rank latest within millions or tens of millions of years.”

“If we don’t visit now, and wait until he enters the Fourth Rank, the meaning will be different.”

Da Ling Ancestor nodded, saying: “Our world being able to give birth to a new Ancestor is good news.”

“Not just a new Ancestor.” Thunder Origin Ancestor shook his head: “I foresee Galaxy Venerate traversing deep into the Fourth Rank, highly likely to step into the Time Lord level.”

The Time Lord is the peak level of Fourth Rank, such beings begin to consolidate their own timelines, advancing towards the Fourteenth Rank, the Perfect Time Being.

“Only because Galaxy Venerate remains at the Venerate level can we still glimpse into the future. Once he steps into the Fourth Rank, attempting to peer into the future will be akin to climbing the heavens.”

Xuanyin Ancestor remarked.

The other ancestors nodded.

Directly glimpsing the future of a time life is exceedingly difficult, only deductions and guesses can be made by observing numerous timelines.

If Galaxy Venerate steps into the Fourth Rank, given the potential shown in future timelines, wanting further glimpses would be nearly impossible.

“It’s about time, let’s go in.”

Da Fu Ancestor looked towards the distant Fierce Sun capital, softly speaking.

…

Galaxy Royal Mansion.

Lin Yuan finished his retreat, with a renewed understanding of Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule, feeling quite good.

At this moment.

Fierce Sun Ancestor’s voice came: “Galaxy, Da Fu and the other five wish to visit you, shall you meet them?”

“Da Fu and the five of them…”

Lin Yuan was taken aback; to be addressed as such by Fierce Sun Ancestor referred to none other than the other five ancestors.

“Should I meet them?” Lin Yuan asked.

“Meet them, it is beneficial.”

Fierce Sun Ancestor replied.

“Alright.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

Soon.

Lin Yuan encountered the five ancestors at the imperial palace.

“Greetings to the ancestors.”

Lin Yuan was slightly reserved, considering they were five time life beings, especially Da Fu Ancestor, a strong one among time lives.

“This realm has produced such a figure; I’ve wanted to come for a long time. I was just concerned about disturbing you, Galaxy brother.”

Primordial Ancestor of the Barbaric Wilderness looked at Lin Yuan, grinned: “Galaxy brother, you need not stand on ceremony with us; let’s interact as equals, don’t be a stranger.”
